title: 2021 Nissan Altima Dent Repair
summary: Rear panel and hood dent repair with color-matched painting on a blue 2021 Nissan Altima.
story: A 2021 Nissan Altima arrived with denting on the rear body panel and scuffs along the hood edge. Proper metal straightening and surface preparation were required to restore the original body lines.
Technicians repaired the dented body panel and hood areas. After leveling the metal and finishing the bodywork, the panels were primed to prepare for topcoat refinishing.
The shop formulated blue paint to match the factory finish. Refinishing both the hood and rear panel restored the exterior finish with seamless color blending across the vehicle.
